title: Diagonal Wrap
author: Claude
blurb: One map, one road, laid two ways. The map wraps: walk off the bottom and you come in at the top. In level 1 the road runs straight down and wraps once. In level 2 it is tilted a little, so it wraps three times and is three times as far on the very same map. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and tilt a road of your own.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie follows a road between hedges. The map wraps at every edge: walk off the bottom and you come in at the top. Laid straight, the road wraps once. Tilted a little, the same road goes round three times and is three times as far. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and tilt a road of your own.
features: Level 1 runs straight down the map and wraps once; level 2 is the same road tilted, so it wraps three times
A dashed line marks the map's edge on the road
Signs in the levels count the laps and the length
Made to be copied and taken apart
